purpose: silver_nyc_weather is the cleaned hourly weather observation table for the three New York area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) landed in bronze.nyc_weather, typed from DECIMAL(38,9) and VARCHAR to narrow numeric and timestamp types and stripped of capture metadata. It feeds flight delay and operations analytics that join weather conditions to departures by airport and observation hour.
usage: Read one row per origin airport per time_hour; join to flight data on origin plus the truncated-to-hour departure timestamp. time_hour is UTC (every sample ends in Z) and is authoritative; year, month, day and hour are convenience parts derived from the same observation. Filter or coalesce deliberately on the nullable measures: check is_wind_gust_reported before averaging wind_gust, and expect missing pressure for roughly 11.5% of rows.
limitations: The declared grain of origin plus time_hour is inferred from distinct_count 3 and 4341 against row_count 13014 and has not been measured in the warehouse; a reviewer must confirm uniqueness before approval. Coverage is partial: year has a single distinct value (2013) and month only 1.0 through 6.0, so this is a half-year extract, not a full year. Sparse measures are retained without imputation: wind_gust is null for 74.55% of rows, pressure for 11.50%, wind_dir for 1.68% and wind_speed for 2 rows. The cleanup does not validate physical plausibility, for example the wind_speed max of 1048.36058 is far outside expected surface wind ranges and is left as landed.
